details.description: Dobby-Mini-Unhinged-Plus-Llama-3.1-8B is an 8-billion-parameter chat model from Sentient (SentientAGI), fine-tuned from Meta's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct to have a deliberately casual, opinionated, pro-crypto 'unhinged' personality rather than a neutral corporate-assistant tone. It is Sentient's improved successor to Dobby-Mini-Unhinged-Llama-3.1-8B, with changes the maker describes as targeting general utility -- formatting, multi-turn performance, and tone -- while keeping baseline Llama 3.1 academic performance. It remains governed by Meta's Llama 3.1 Community License Agreement.
advantages: Improves formatting-consistency score to 0.95 from 0.35 for its Dobby-Mini-Unhinged predecessor, per Sentient's model card.
Maintains baseline Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct academic performance, scoring 0.3774 on MMLU-Pro per Sentient's model card.
Scores 0.87 out of 1.0 on Sentient's own 'unhinged tone' evaluation.
disadvantages: Knowledge cutoff of December 2023, inherited from the Llama 3.1 base model.
Deliberately casual tone that can include profanity and strong opinions rather than neutral assistant behavior; Sentient says investment or legal opinions from it require independent verification.
Governed by Meta's Llama 3.1 Community License Agreement rather than a fully permissive open-source license.
use_cases: General conversational chat emphasizing personality and authenticity over a formal, neutral assistant tone.
Multi-turn dialogue with a distinctive, opinionated character.

notes: MMLU-Pro (0.3774) and the 'unhinged tone' (0.87) and formatting (0.95 vs 0.35) figures on the model card are given on a 0-1 scale rather than the maker's own percentage figures, so I did not place them in the structured evaluations list (which requires a 0-100 accuracy score); they are quoted in advantages instead, attributed to the maker's card.
